versions.content: Each call to Dem_J1939DcmGetNextDTCwithLampStatus shall search within the event memory (set by the function Dem_- J1939DcmFirstDTCwithLampStatus ) for the next event having a J1939DTC assigned. In case no more events are available that have a J1939DTC assigend, the function return value shall be DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT. The out parameter needs not to be valid in this case.
